summary: Auth Phase 1 (Emergent Google OAuth) — backend + frontend testing complete. All 8 pytest tests pass and all 6 UI flows pass. Sign-in/out, role assignment (guardian vs visitor), session expiry, logout cleanup, and chamber regression (Paige /hospitality) all verified. App is NOT stuck on splash; Sign in pill renders logged-out; injected guardian cookie surfaces 'David' + 'Guardian' mark; visitor cookie surfaces user with no guardian mark; logout returns to signed-out state; IdentityBridge correctly syncs verified identity into chambers.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py session expiry handles both string and naive datetime — good. Token resolution falls back from cookie to Bearer — correct.
AuthContext useEffect correctly skips /me call when returning from OAuth (hash carries session_id). Loading state initialised conditionally — avoids splash flash on OAuth return.
AppShell renders AuthCallback when hash contains session_id — but the route is also reachable via /login etc. The hash check is global which is correct for any-route return.
DB_NAME is 'test_database' in /app/backend/.env — this is the project's real database in this preview env (the playbook explicitly notes to use MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env). No change needed.

Initial /api/auth/me 401s are visible in browser console when logged-out — expected and benign, but consider downgrading to debug-only logging or silencing in AuthContext.refresh() catch (cosmetic only).
App.js is ~400 lines and growing; consider extracting AppShell/Stars/HiddenDoor/IdentityBridge into a separate file when next touched (>700 line threshold not yet hit).
test_credentials: Injected Mongo sessions: guardian token 'qa_david_tok' (user_id=qa-david, email=davebouchez@gmail.com), visitor token 'qa_visitor_tok' (user_id=qa-visitor, email=visitor.qa@example.com). Both re-seeded after testing for next iterations. DB: mongodb://localhost:27017/test_database.
seed_data_creation: Inserted qa-david (guardian) and qa-visitor (visitor) into db.users and matching docs into db.user_sessions. Expired and logout-throwaway sessions were created during the run and cleaned up. Guardian session was re-seeded after the UI logout test deleted it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 auth is fully functional and verified. Real Google OAuth was NOT tested (external, intentional). To re-test, the two QA sessions (qa_david_tok / qa_visitor_tok) are seeded in Mongo — use Bearer header for API or session_token cookie for browser. Phase 2 (route gating) is not yet implemented — anonymous users still reach chambers; this is expected. The 401 console logs on initial logged-out load are expected (AuthContext refresh()).
